summary.headline: Valens’s Zodiac and Planetary Sums
summary.text: Valens’s numerical sums for the twelve zodiac signs, calculated from their elements and configurations—hexagon, square, trine, and diameter. It then demonstrates how to derive planetary sums from domicile, exaltation, and opposition, using Saturn, Mars, and Jupiter.
